Side stage lounges: open rectangular white seating around a central area, approximately twenty-five or more. Do not assign these descriptions to numbered inventory without organizer confirmation.

Organizer imports and edits price lists, photographs, menu sections, bottle packages, modifiers, allergens, explicit taxes/service charges/currency, stock, service zones, last-order cutoffs and age/staff checks. Preview before publish; version conflicts and rollback; no inferred free prices or stock.

Guest ordering from verified table context routes bottles/drinks to assigned servers and bar queues with accepted/preparing/ready/delivered/rejected states, staff override audit, sold-out recovery, duplicate-request protection and reconnect reconciliation.

Full bill splitting before and during event: ticket shares, own items, equal/custom amounts, shared bottle allocations, discounts, taxes, service charge, optional tips, paid/refunded balances, cash staff receipts, outstanding shares and late orders. Exact money conservation and concurrent payment reservation; no client-paid status.

Temporary inventory holds with expiry, atomic table/seat confirmation and payment reconciliation. Distinguish source-plan preferences, private saved plans, enquiries, held inventory and actual tickets; no fabricated available seats.

Subtle disclosed actionable sponsorship on table details, bottle/menu context and event screens: active scoped organizer-approved placements, frequency caps, offer expiry, redemption authorization, accessible touch alternative to hover, no automatic popups covering seat or checkout controls.

Event social sharing: shareable public event cards and deep links, opt-in guest photo/video submissions and hashtags, organizer moderation, content rights and people permission, revocation/removal, screen-safe projection, expiry, reporting, event-scoped media retention and authorized provider ingestion. Hashtag alone is not public-screen consent.

Drag and drop for authorized organizer table layouts, sponsor placements and menu order, and guest-owned group/itinerary/shared-item organization. Keyboard/buttons alternative, touch support, undo, stale versions, permission checks; guests cannot change inventory or other groups.

Scoped messaging: guest-to-organizer questions, private invited-group planning, table-to-assigned-server assistance, order-linked issues, staff handoff, block/report, mute, rate limits, attachment checks, participant revocation, delivery receipts and no cross-tenant or cross-table leakage.
